opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to an Ethereum payment, recruitment, and continued upgrading through Forsage’s matrix structure. It states that a participant will “donate 0.025 Ethereum from level 1 to the person that is invited you,” then links incoming payments to recruited people, explaining that “The first person that you invite, they also send you 0.025 Ethereum.” It encourages participants to use those receipts to “upgrade to the next level,” and warns that without upgrading, “you stop receiving payments.” The presentation further connects repeating levels and earnings to bringing in partners in X3 and X4, while stating that potential income depends on “the size of the team that you decide to build.” Although it calls the examples illustrative and not guaranteed, that qualification does not remove the payment, recruitment, and upgrade conditions underlying the proposed earnings.
